Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
Michael Beer wrote:
>
> Dartmoor, England, unique location:
>
> "The vampire with this location gets +1 stealth on each action requiring
> Animalism or Protean"
>
> Includes this employ retainer actions? (This may be also an action
> requiring Animalism or Protean...)

Yes. It would also include any Animalism-requiring equip actions,
political actions, and recruit ally actions (if any existed).

Specifically, it gives +1 stealth to the following:
Army of Rats (but not the action to burn)
Jackal [AH]
Murder of Crows
Owl Companion
Raptor [SAB]
Raven Spy
Shepherd's Innocence [DS]
Tier of Souls [SAB]
Wolf Companion

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
(*) - Subject to review by Rules Team
